board: New York State Education Department — State Board for Public Accountancy

cycle.note: CPE is tracked January 1 – December 31 each year. No credits carry forward to the next year.

requirements.label: Annual CPE
requirements.note: 40 hours in any mix of recognized subject areas, or 24 hours in one area (accounting, attest, auditing, taxation, advisory services or specialized knowledge). No carryforward.

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: 4 hours in the three calendar years before your registration renews. If your principal place of business is in New York, it must be a New York State-specific ethics course.

requirements.label: Attest competency (accounting, auditing & attest)
requirements.note: If you supervise attest or compilation work or sign reports: 40 hours in accounting, auditing or attest in the prior three calendar years, or in the year you do the work. Separate from the 24-hour option.

newLicensee.note: New licensees start on the first January 1 that falls in their first registration period.
